module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic reset,
    input  logic [7:0] d,
    output logic [7:0] q
);

    // 8 positive-edge-triggered D flip-flops with active-high synchronous reset
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset)
            q <= 8'b0;   // reset sets output to zero
        else
            q <= d;      // otherwise capture the input
    end

endmodule
